short_summary: Job 4 backlog was down to a single business, COFI (Savannah Mall, Fauna Park). Researched via WebSearch snippets (WebFetch blocked as usual) -- rewrote its description with genuine details on cuisine/offerings, added a new source, and recorded trading hours (08:00-02:00 daily). Backlog is now empty.

Seshego Zone 1: searched (clinics, hardware, pharmacy, tavern/salon queries) but every result matched a business already in the dataset or lacked a second independent source and/or a confirmed phone+address for this exact location; no new businesses met the publish bar. No shopping centre in this suburb.

Seshego Zone 4: searched (salons, motel/spa, New Era Drive businesses) but every plausible lead was either already in the dataset, a mobile service based in a different zone (Seshego-G, outside this suburb's boundary), or lacked a second source and confirmed address for this exact location. No new businesses met the publish bar. No shopping centre in this suburb.

Mankweng: added Turf Lodge (guesthouse near University of Limpopo, corner University Rd & Houtbosdorp Rd) with 2 independent sources for name/address/phone. Discarded KPK Lodge (no confirmed street address, only a generic 'unnamed road' locational description), a TMJ Global Consultancy lead near Gate 2 (single Facebook source, no street address), and 'Cross Road Centre' as a candidate new shopping centre (couldn't confirm it's a genuine multi-tenant mall vs. just a street corner with the two pharmacies already in the dataset). Already-dense suburb (65 existing businesses); no other new finds cleared the bar.

Checked 5 businesses starting after 'absa-bank-metlife-plaza-lebowakgomo' (Absa Savannah Mall, Absa Turfloop Plaza, Ackermans Mall@Lebo, Ackermans Paledi Mall, Ackermans Seshego Circle) -- one search returned an ambiguous 'closed' status for two of the chain branches but none showed a literal 'Permanently closed' tag, so no changes made. closed_check_last_slug now 'ackermans-seshego-circle-seshego'.

Job 4 backlog contained only 'turf-lodge-mankweng' (a brand-new business added this run's earlier mankweng checkpoint, which starts with description_enriched_at null like any fresh insert). Searched for additional facts/hours via WebSearch snippets but found nothing beyond what was already verified at publish time -- kept the existing specific description as-is (reworded case, no new source) and marked it enriched. Backlog is empty again.

Lebowakgomo: added MNC Dental Clinic (Shop 52A, Mall@Lebo) with 2 independent directory sources agreeing on name/phone/address, linked to the existing mall-lebo-lebowakgomo shopping centre. Discarded Mr Price Lebowakgomo (sources conflict on shop number/phone/even which centre -- Lepelle Crossing vs Lebowa Metropolitan Centre -- couldn't confidently pin address+phone to this branch) and a batch of hair salon leads (only social-media mentions, no verifiable phone or street address). Confirmed 'Lepelle Crossing'/'Lebowa Metropolitan Centre' referenced by some directories are the same physical Mall@Lebo (same cnr R518/R579 address, same tenants e.g. Mr Price, Ackermans) -- not a new shopping centre. Already-dense suburb (54 existing businesses).

Futura (industrial park): searched panel beaters, scrap metal, bearings/hydraulics suppliers. Every lead was either an existing business under a different (matching phone/address) listing (Northern Auto Panelbeaters = same address+phone as already-published Auto Magic Polokwane), already in the dataset under a different suburb (Bearings International and Fena Bearings are on Witklip St, Ladanna, not Futura -- a generic directory page had mis-grouped them), had only a partial/unconfirmed phone number (Connies Scrap Metals), or had conflicting addresses across sources for what may be several different similarly-named entities (Diesel Hydraulics / Polokwane Diesel & Hydraulics / Max Hydraulics / Diesel & Hydraulics CC, spread across Futura/Dalmada/Pietersburg St with no single one confidently pinned). No new businesses met the publish bar this run. No shopping centre in this suburb.

Polokwane Central: added LZ Makwela Accountants (6 Hans van Rensburg St) with 3 sources (own site plus Procompare and ShopsHours directories) agreeing on name/phone/address. Discarded M Tramabala Attorneys and Lande Consulting (both only ever surfaced on their own website, no independent second source found despite repeated searches) and Madale Scheepers Optometrist (address confirmed but no phone number found anywhere). Already-dense suburb (92 existing businesses); no shopping-centre leads found.
